summary: Very steep narrow lane with No Stopping signs and homes close by.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11 m at 17 m along and 12 m at 11 m; townhouses across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with no shoulder, trees and fence on both sides; nowhere to pull off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane off a busy junction with Miskin Street.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen; No Stopping signs line the kerb.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs along it
sun_shade: Mixed tree shade, mostly from the west side.
